supporting_observations.claim: The alerted HTTPS checks are attributed to C:\Program Files\GradeBookPro\gradebookproupd.exe (PID 6024), which started shortly before the first observed check and initiated the connection through the explicit proxy.

The same updater repeatedly connected to update.gradebookpro.com at roughly five-minute intervals: 13:37:44, 13:42:39, 13:47:35, 13:51:57, 13:56:59, 14:02:21, and 14:07:25 UTC. This matches the documented behavior of the approved GradeBook Pro updater.
Endpoint network events attribute the repeated proxy connections to PID 6024 and the GradeBook Pro updater, including the final connection attempt at 14:07:25; the updater then exited at 14:07:43.

Some updater checks did not succeed: the proxy denied a request at 13:47:35 and returned a gateway error at 14:07:25. These outcomes do not change the process and destination attribution of the periodic activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT requests and tunnel metadata, not the full encrypted HTTPS payload.
The evidence does not include a binary hash or signature-validation result for the GradeBook Pro updater.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents of the HTTPS exchanges or independently validate the remote server beyond the hostname recorded by the proxy.
The evidence does not establish whether the updater was interacting with the svc-grades job or its scheduled password rotation; no such link is shown.
